iconography.realia_identification: Olive or date palm branchlet used in ritual aspersions
iconography.iconographic_notes: Identified in Evans (1909), Duhoux (1977), and Godart (1995) as Branch / Twig.

phonetics.epistemic_warning: Phonetic value ['/te/'] is an unverified projection from Linear A/B. Cannot be considered established decipherment.

expert_synthesis: Phaistos Disc Sign 35 (Branch / Twig) depicts Olive or date palm branchlet used in ritual aspersions. Iconographically, it correlates with Cretan Hieroglyphic CH_025 and Linear A AB04. Proposed phonetic assignments ['/te/'] remain tentative under the Shannon unicity limit.
skeptic_ruling: SKEPTIC RULING (Sign 35): Physical stamping die observed. Realia classification (Branch / Twig) is well-supported by Middle Minoan iconography. Phonetic projection ['/te/'] carries high degrees of freedom and must be treated as a working hypothesis.
